# Research checklist: every category, one at a time

**Started:** 2026-11-21. **Owner:** Adam decides; Claude researches and builds.
**Built from:** `main` at commit af4f65c (after PR #28), using `data/review/taxonomy.json` regenerated by
`node scripts/taxonomy-export.mjs` (no change from the committed copy), the verb structure in
`src/lib/taxonomy.mjs` and docs/INFORMATION_ARCHITECTURE.md, and the gap notes in docs/research/ and
data/research/overnight-2026-11-21/.

**Today:** 6,152 records. 5,928 included by Adam, 28 excluded, 196 pending (the overnight 2026-11-21 additions).
Counts below are records placed in each subcategory; a record can sit in more than one, so they don't add up.
"Off / Unoff" is the Official and "Unofficial and inspired" shelves.

---

## How each category is worked (Adam's process, 2026-11-21)

Each category goes through four boxes, in order. Nothing is researched before box 1 is ticked, and no page is
built before box 3 is ticked.

1. **Content plan approved.** A one-page plan in `docs/plans/research-<category>.md`: scope (in, out, edge cases),
   what each record and the landing page show, which media and documents attach, cross-links to People, Places,
   Organizations and the Media Library, the sources to mine with the fetch budget they need, and open questions
   with a recommendation for each. Adam approves or changes it.
2. **Researched.** Every candidate found from verified sources only. Each record carries how it connects to the
   show, its tier and why, a recommendation and why, and a source link. All start pending. Delivered as a pull
   request to `main` that passes CI, plus a review sheet of only the new records.
3. **Records decided.** Adam includes or excludes each record in the sheet.
4. **Pages built.** The category's pages built thoroughly, professionally and concisely; screenshots at 320 px and
   1440 px go to Adam before merge.

**Every content plan includes a "Blessing-ready" section** (Adam, 2026-11-21): how the category earns the trust of
CBS/Paramount and the Serling family through accuracy, sourcing, respect for their property, honoring the
creators, a professional finish and no commercial use. It also covers **credit where credit is due**: creators, rights holders, sources, researchers
and contributing fans are named for every record, image, quote and fact. The Television plan's section 9a is the
model.

**Depth key:** **Deep** = complete against a known full list, or searched to exhaustion. **Partial** = the main
items are in, but known gaps or unverified rows remain. **Thin** = a start only; most of what exists is not yet
recorded.

**Fetch budget:** about 100 web fetches an hour, shared with any other thread. Each plan states how many fetches
the research needs, and the larger categories run over several hours or overnight.

---

## Recommended order

Works first, directories after: researching a work turns up its people, characters, organizations and places,
so the directory passes at the end mostly fill in and tidy. Within the works, the core of the franchise comes
first because everything else links to it.

| # | Category | Why here |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Watch: TV series and episodes** (incl. Night Gallery and Serling's other TV) | The core every other page links to. The Twilight Zone series are complete, but Serling's other television is thin (22 of the 200+ teleplays he sold), and Night Gallery segments have no pages of their own. |
| 2 | Watch: Movies | 200 of the 555 work-to-episode links are "fan-noted" only, and most sit here. Documentaries and unmade projects are small. |
| 3 | Listen: Radio | Already deep; a short pass that adds Serling's own radio career (5 records today). |
| 4 | Read: Books and Scripts | The stories the episodes adapt have no records of their own; novelizations, editions and translations are partial. |
| 5 | Read: Comics and Magazines | Already deep; a quick verification pass and cover-art links. |
| 6 | Read: Articles, Essays and Websites | Articles and websites are partial to thin. |
| 7 | Listen: Music | Done 2026-11-24: six shelves, music on 34 episode pages. 54 songs still "not yet confirmed". |
| 8 | Listen: Podcasts | Done 2026-11-24: three shelves (no official podcast found), 3,323 episodes in one searchable table. |
| 9 | Watch: Stage | Done 2026-11-24: five shelves and the play page. |
| 10 | Play: Games | Done 2026-11-24: five shelves, one shelf per record, five duplicates merged. |
| 11 | Collect: Artwork | Thin in prints, cover artists and title design. |
| 12 | Collect: Merchandise | Home video has only 2 records; "Other merchandise" (33) needs splitting. |
| 13 | Attend: Events | "Other events" holds 39 records that are really history milestones. |
| 14 | Attend: Lectures and talks | Partial; leads listed. |
| 15 | Discover: History | Rebuilt overnight; needs a date-check and the timeline gaps. |
| 16 | Discover: Legacy | The largest (758). 135 links are still unconfirmed, and the fan-made shelf is empty. |
| 17 | Meet: People | Deep for credits; about 100 named people still unidentified, no showrunners. |
| 18 | Meet: Characters | Deep for the four TZ series; Night Gallery and the radio dramas have none. |
| 19 | Meet: Organizations | Thin (65), and fictional organizations have none. |
| 20 | Visit: Real places | Partial. |
| 21 | Visit: Settings | Thin: 35 settings across 394 episodes. |
| 22 | Media Library content | Quotes (34) and archive holdings (10) are thin; reviews are partial. Content is gathered while doing 1–21, so this pass only closes what is left. |

## Found, for later (not part of this checklist's research)

- 39 Serling-life milestones show in both Attend > Other events and Discover > History; they belong only in History.
- The 1985 scheduling and 1988–89 syndication records sit under Screenings and marathons; they are History.
- `works/twilight-zone-accident-1982` has no categories.
- Songs carry a `subtype: sample` key the schema does not define.
